title: Is What You Ask For What You Get? Investigating Concept Associations in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the frequency of 'man' versus 'woman' concepts in images generated from profession-based prompts using object detectors, and analyzing concept co-occurrences to detect hyper-sexualized representations of women in human-preference datasets.

Prompting text-to-image models with various disabilities (e.g., cerebral palsy, limb difference) and analyzing the frequency and co-occurrence of detected concepts (e.g., wheelchairs, shorts, hospital beds) to identify reductive archetypes and stereotypes.

Analyzing object and action associations in images generated from age-modified prompts (e.g., 'young', 'middle-aged', 'old'), as well as detecting unsafe, hyper-sexualized concept co-occurrences associated with children/minors (CSAM) in prompt datasets.

Examining concept co-occurrences and visual representations for prompts containing specific racial or ethnic identifiers (e.g., 'Asian woman', 'Afrikan woman') to detect hyper-sexualization, and identifying racially skewed visual alignments (e.g., skin tones and hairstyles like dreadlocks) in synthetic datasets.
